tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sa bcad bzhugs pa lags so//

"$ ༄༅// bla ma rnams dang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las bsdus pa'i rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa 'di la gnyis te/ 'grel pa'i mtshan dang*/ gzhung gi don to// de la le'u lnga/ mdor bsdus sum cu rtsa gnyis/ gnas pa brgyad cu rtsa gcig /nang tshan dbye ba lnga brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa drug las/ le'u dang po 'grel pa dang bcas pa la mdor bsdus bcu las/ dang po gsum gyis rgyud la 'jug pa dang*/ bdun gyis gzhung gi don bstan pa la/ dang po bdud 'dul ba'i phyir mchog tu 'dod pa'i lha la bstod cing*/ mchod par brjod pa dang*/ bshad par dam bca' ba dang gnyis las/ dang po la gsum/ 'bras bu sku bzhi la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ bskyed rdzogs kyi don la phyag 'tshal ba'o// dang po la bzhi/ don dam pa'i bden pa'i sku dang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i ngo bo dang*/ de kho na nyid bcu drug dang*/ bden pa bcu gnyis dag pa'i sprul sku dang*/ sku gsum dbyer med pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ byang chub kyi sems dang*/ rten dang brten pa'i sku e baṃ dang*/ phyag rgya chen po la phyag 'tshal ba'o// gsum pa la drug ste/ sna tshogs yum la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba dang*/ dag pa'i sku dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor dang*/ nyi zla dbang du bya ba'i sgo nas dbang*/ gdan gyi yon tan gyi sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba'o// bshad par dam bca' ba la gsum/ 'chad par byed pa'i rgyu mtshan mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// dang po la gsum/ sdud pa po dang mthun zhing khe'u bskyung ba dang*/ bsdus rgyud 'byung ba'i rgyu dang*/ rtsa 'grel gyi gzhung tshad dang bcas te bshad par dam bca' ba'o// rgyas bshad la bzhi/ bshad par la 'jug pa'i tshul dang*/ lam gyi khyad par dang*/ lam la bar du gcod pa dang*/

lam bsgoms pa'i phan yon no// dang po la bzhi/ ji ltar mnyan pa'i tshul dang*/ gzhan gyi lugs ngan spang ba dang*/ 'grel pa byed pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ 'grel pa'i phan yon no// lam gyi khyad par la bzhi/ khyad par dngos dang*/ sgra tshig gi khyad par dang*/ don gyi rjes su 'jug pa'i 'thad pa bshad pa dang*/ 'dzag pa dang mi 'dzag pa'i khyad par ro// de la gsum/ a mra'i 'bras bu dang*/ bya tsa ta ka dang*/ seng ge dang*/ phug ron dang*/ 'dod ldan dang*/ dka' thub pa dang*/ sbrul gyis rmugs pa'i dpe rnams kyis 'dzag pa'i skyon bshad pa dang*/ rdo dreg gi skud pa dang*/ dngul chu dang*/ srub stan/ srub shing gi dpes 'dzag pa nyid 'dzag med du byed pa dang*/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i lam bshad pa'o// lam la bar du gcod pa la bzhi/ chom rkun mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas bshad dang*/ chom rkun dor ba'i tshul dang*/ dor nas yang dag pa'i lam brten pa'o// phan yon la gsum las/ phan yon mdor bstan pa dang*/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad kyis gnas skabs kyi phan yon 'jigs pa bcu drug sel ba'i tshul dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i don bshad pa mthar thug gi phan yon no// mdor bsdu ba la gsum las/ 'grel pa ji ltar byas tshul/ dus 'khor gyi don bsdu ba/ myur bar 'chad pa'o// mdor bsdus dang po'o// gnyis pa brjod bya/ rjod byed mdor bsdus te bstan pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po la lnga/ dgos 'brel mdor bstan pa dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga dang*/ bsdus rgyud mdzad pa po dang*/ le'u lnga dang*/ gnas pa brgyad cu rtsa gcig mdor bstan pa'o// de'i le'u dang po la nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ gnyis pa la bco brgyad/ gsum pa la bcu gnyis/ bzhi pa la bdun/ lnga pa la nyi shu ste/ brgyad cu rtsa gcig go /rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ dgos 'brel rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga dang*/ rgyud 'grel gzhan du sdud pa'i tshul rgyas bshad do// dang po la gnyis/

brjod bya/ rjod byed dang*/ 'brel pa dang*/ dgos pa dang*/ dgos pa'i dgos pa rnams kyis rgyas bshad dngos dang*/ rdo rje'i theg pa spyi'i don to// de la drug ste/ gdul bya gang la dgos pa gang gi phyir bstan pa dang*/ mi'i 'gro ba las gzhan gyis mi 'grub pa dang*/ tshe gcig gis 'grub pa'i 'thad pa dang*/ tshig tsam gyis ma yin pa dang*/ zhar la dam tshig gi rdzas rung mi rung lung dang bcas pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun par bstan pa'o// gnyis pa phun sum tshogs pa la lnga/ don dam dang kun rdzob kyi dbye bas gnas dang*/ 'khor dang*/ rnam grangs drug gis ston pa dang*/ sdud pa po zla ba bzang po dang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyi nang du sbyar bas dus shugs la bstan pa dang*/ chos phun sum tshogs pa'o// de la drug /gzhung 'grel gyi brjod byed kyi tshad dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i don mdor bstan pa dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i rgyud rgyas bshad dang*/ de sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs pa'i tshul dang*/ de la rtsod pa spang ba dang*/ rgyud thams cad kyis sbas pa'i don bshad pa'o// de la bdun te/ rgyud gzhan du sbas pa 'dir bstan pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i lam gyi rtags dang*/ sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog bshad pa dang*/ bden pa gnyis kyi dbye ba/ mngon par byang chub pa bzhi bshad pa/ sku bzhi la sogs pa'i sbyang gzhi sbyong byed mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// de la brgyad/ sku bzhi dang*/ rigs drug dang bden pa bcu gnyis dang*/ stong nyid bcu drug dang*/ snying rje bcu drug dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang dang*/ phyag rgya'i don to// gsum pa rtsa ba'i rgyud ston pa po dang*/ bsdud pa po'i 'brel ba ston pa'i mdor bsdus la gsum ste/ ston pa dang bsdud pa po bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul dang*/ bye brag tu rgyud 'di bsdus pa dang*/ 'grel pa dang*/ ston par byed pa lung bstan pa bshad pa dang*/

nyi ma'i shing rta btul ba'i rim pa'o// dang po la lnga/ tshig gi rjes su 'breng ba rnams kyi 'gal ba'i skyon brjod pa 'gog pa/ zhar la bdud btul ba'i nges pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul de dpes bshad pa/ 'grel pa brjod pa dngos so// gnyis pa lung bstan pa bshad pa la gsum/ mtshams sbyar ba/ lung bstan dngos/ de rgyas par bshad pa'o// gsum pa nyi ma'i shing rta brtul ba la lnga/ dus la bab par mkhyen pa/ gnas gang du/ dus gang gi tshe/ tshul ji ltar btul ba/ btul nas rgyud ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul lo// tshul ji ltar btul ba la bzhi ste/ bka' stsal pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyis btul ba/ blon pos bstan te dul ba'i tshul/ dul nas rgyud zhus pa'i tshul lo// bzhi pa ston pa po dang*/ zhu ba po'i bsgrub pa bstan pa'i mdor bsdus la bzhi ste/ mtshams sbyar ba dang*/ gleng gzhi dngos dang*/ de'i rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ mjug bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ phun sum tshogs pa la spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu ston pa dang*/ gnas dang*/ 'khor dang*/ zhu ba po dang*/ chos dang*/ dgos pa phun sum tshogs pa bstan pa'o// gsum pa de'i rgyas bshad la bzhi ste/ 'dir thams cad mkhyen pa la sogs pa'i ngag gis bstan pa'i the tshom bsal ba dang*/ zhar la e wam̐ gyi don bshad pa dang*/ rgyud kyi nges pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum/ rgol ba dang*/ lan gyis/ gleng gzhi la zhen pa spang ba dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pas skad du mas gsungs pa'i tshul dang*/ bye brag tu rgyud kyi gleng gzhi tha dad pa bshad pa'o// de la lnga/ 'dus pa dang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dang*/ dang po'i rtsa rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor rjes su rig pa dang*/ 'bum pa rnams kyi gleng gzhi dang*/ zhu ba po tha dad pa'i tshul dang*/ legs sbyar bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan no// gnyis pa e waṃ gyi don bshad pa la drug don gcig gis ming mang po 'dzin pa'i tshul dang*/

shes rab mtshon pa'i ming*/ thabs mtshon pa'i ming*/ gnyis med kyi ming*/ ming bstan pa'i dgos pa/ gzugs dang sgra bsgrub pa don dang bcas pa'o// gsum pa rgyud kyi nges pa la gsum/ rgyud thams cad mtha' drug gis gdam pa'i tshul/ nges don gyi rgyud kyi rigs kyi don mdor bstan dang*/ rigs kyi rgyas par bshad pa'o// bzhi pa rgyas bshad la brgyad/ thams cad mkhyen pa bshad pa/ de'i gsung la the tshom spang ba/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang*/ ye shes kyi sku dang*/ nyi ma'i lus dang*/ pad ma'i 'dab ma bzhin spangs pa'i spyan bshad pa ma zlos par bshad pa dang*/ gnas rgyas bshad dang*/ zhar la khyab 'jug la sogs pas bshad pa phan byed ma yin par bstan pa'o// de la bzhi/ khyab 'jug la sogs pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ma yin pa dang*/ thams cad du phan byed ma yin pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' ni de las gzhan pas mchod na yon tan ster ba'i tshul dang*/ bstan pa gnas pa'i tshul lo// mjug bsdu ba la gsum/ chos sdud pa pos so sor bsdus tshul dang*/ yon tan thams cad dang ldan na mu stegs la yang gus par bya ba'i tshul dang*/ rgyud 'di'i sdud byed bshad pa'o// lnga pa rdo rje rnal 'byor bsdu ba la gsum/ bden pa gnyis kyis bsdus pa mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ dgos pa dang dgos pa'i dgos pa bsdu ba'o// rgyas bshad la gnyis/ rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi lam dang*/ 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag go /de la bdun te/ phar phyin gyi 'bras bu dang*/ de sngags kyi 'bras bu la sbyar ba dang*/ zung 'jug gi chos mi mthun pa dpe dang rigs pas bstan pa dang*/ zung 'jug gi dpe don lung dang bcas pa dang*/ de rtogs pas srid zhi spangs pa dang*/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba dang*/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed rgyas par bshad pa'o// skad cig sbyor ba lnga/ skad gis mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul dang*/ de rtogs pas skye 'gag mi dmigs pa dang*/

'thad pa'i rig pa dang*/ mtha' bral du bstan pa dang*/ don sdu ba'o// sbyang gzhi sbyong byed rgyas bshad la drug dga' ba bzhi dang bcu drug gi dbye ba/ de sku la sbyar ba/ rnam thar dang rnal 'byor bzhi sbyar ba dang*/ sku'i don bsdu ba dang*/ gnas skabs bzhi la sbyar ba dang*/ nang gi rtsod pa bstan pa'o// gsum pa dgos pa bsdu ba la gnyis te/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug go drug pa zhus pa'i mdor bsdus la gnyis te/ le'u lnga'i don phyi nang gzhan gsum du gnas pa brdas mtshon te zhus pa dang*/ de'i don bshad pa'o// de la bzhi/ stong pa chen po yi ge lnga dang thig le stong pa yi ge drug gis thabs shes rab kyi ngo bo bstan pa dang*/ rigs las lhar grub pa'i tshul dang*/ mu stegs pa gzhug pa'i phyir skyes bu nyi shu rtsa lnga phyi nang du sbyar ba dang*/ dbang bshad pa'o// dang po la bdun te/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ don bsdu bas stong pa chen po'i yi ge lnga bshad pa dang*/ de dbyangs dang sbyar ba ro drug dang sbyar/ shes rab kyi ngo bo sde tshan drug dang sbyar ba dang*/ gsal byed la sogs pa'i dbye ba bsdus pa dang*/ e bam̐ gyi nges pa dang zhar la zhal gyi dag pa/ dkar dmar gyi dar rgud la brten nas rigs bshad pa'o// dbang bshad pa la bzhi/ dbang dngos dang*/ zhar la phyi ma'i rdo rje slob dpon ngan pa lung bstan pa/ dbang bzhi pa gzhan du mi gsal ba 'dir gsal bar mdzad pa'i tshul/ des na 'di mnyan par gdams pa'o// bdun pa 'jig rten gyi khams bsdus pa mdor bstan pa la gsum ste/ mtshams sbyar ba dang*/ lan mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// mdor bstan pa la gnyis/ dris pa la dgyes pa dang*/ ji ltar dgyes pa'i don to// de la gsum ste/ don gang gis mi shes pa dang*/ gang mi shes pa khams drug ldan pa'i lus dang*/ ngag sngags so// de la bzhi/ sgra'i 'byung ba mdor bstan dang*/ ngag dang de bzhin nyid kyi dbye ba/

sgra'i gnas rgyas par bshad pa/ nyon cig par bskul ba'o// rgyas par bshad pa la drug theg pa gsum gyi dgongs pa dang mthun par rgan pa'i rnam bzhag /bye brag tu smra ba dang mthun par snod bcud chags tshul/ rnam bcu dbang ldan rdo rje'i skur bsgrub/ sgra gcan la sogs pa'i skye ba bsdu ba zung bdun thabs dang shes rab tu bstan pa/ phyi dus kyi 'khor lo sa bon dang sbyar ba/ brtan g.yo thams cad kyi sngags bshad pa'o/ gnyis pa la gsum/ snod dang*/ bcud chags tshul dang*/ dpe bstan pa'o// gsum pa la gnyis/ rdo rje'i skur bsgrub sgra bshad dang bcas pa dang*/ lung gis bshad pa'o// bzhi pa la gsum/ lho byang zung bdun dang*/ shar nub kyi zung bdun thabs shes rab tu bstan pa/ dbus e bam̐ gyi don bshad pa lung dang bcas pa'o// lnga pa phyi dus kyi 'khor lo sa bon dang sbyar ba la dgu/ nyi zla'i 'phel 'grib dang*/ rang bzhin dang 'phel ba dang*/ ya na dhe sha'i yi ge la sbyar ba/ gsal byed tshes la sbyar ba'i rim pa/ nyi zla sgra gcan gyi nges pas ring thung gsum du 'gyur tshul/ 'pho ba bcu gnyis la rgyu ba'i yi ge bstan pa/ nyin mtshan 'phel 'grib kyi yi ge rgyas bshad/ de phyi nang du sbyar bshad/ lung bshad pa/ nyin mtshan 'phel 'grib thabs shes rab tu bstan pa'o// drug pa brtan g.yo thams cad kyi sngags pa la bzhi/ dngos dang*/ de'i nges pa/ zhar la sngags kyi skye gnas bstan pa/ bsgom don du nang du sbyar ba'o// brgyad pa 'jig rten gyi khams bsdus pa'i tshad kyi mdor bstan pa la bzhi/ snod bstan pa dang*/ srid pa sum cu rtsa gcig bstan pa dang*/ 'khor los bsgyur ba dang*/ phra mo'i dbugs la sogs pa de'i rang bzhin du gnas pa'o// dang po la gsum/ mtshams sbyar ba dang*/ phyi snod don dam par ma grub pa'i tshul dang*/ kun rdzob tu grub tshul lo// de la bzhi ste/ gzhal bya'i steng 'og gi tshad/ zheng gi tshad/ mtha' bskor gyi tshad 'jal byed bstan pa'o// gnyis pa bcud srid pa la gnyis/

bstan pa dang*/ bshad pa'o// de la dgu ste/ srid pa gsum dang*/ bskal pa'i tshad dang*/ klu la sogs pa'i tshad dang*/ ri dang*/ rgya mtsho dang*/ gling drug bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu gling bzhi dang*/ lhun po la sogs pa'i tshad dang*/ gnas la sogs pa dang*/ phyogs skyong gi gnas bstan pa'o// gsum pa 'khor lo bsgyur ba 'byung tshul la gnyis te/ ji ltar bskor ba'i tshul dang*/ dus bzhi'i tshad do// bzhi pa phra mo'i dbugs la sogs pa la gsum/ dbugs spyir bstan pa dang*/ de la brten pa so so'i dus dang*/ nges don du sbyar ba'o// dgu pa skar rtsis kyi mdor bsdus la gnas pa la bzhi ste/ 'jam dpal lung bstan pa dang*/ rtsis dang*/ khyim gyi go la dang*/ dbu ma'i dbugs la gza'i rkang pa dang*/ skyes skar gyi rkang pa'o// dang po la gsum/ 'jam dpal lung bstan pa dang*/ zhar la kla klo lung bstan pa dang*/ mu stegs kyi rtsis ma dag par bstan pa'o// gnyis pa rtsis la gnyis te/ rgyu rtsis dang*/ 'bras bu'i rtsis so// rgyu rtsis la lnga/ yan lag lnga dang*/ mu stegs pa'i ming skar gyi 'dod pa dgag pa dang*/ lo 'pho ba dang grub pa'i mtha' la ltos pa'i rtsis dang*/ sgra gcan gyi rtsis dang*/ gza' lnga'o// dang po la bcu gsum ste/ lo dag btsal ba dang*/ zla dag dang*/ gza'i dh+ru ba dang*/ ril cha dang*/ nyi ma'i dh+ru ba dang*/ le lo can dang*/ zla ba'i nyin bzhin 'char ba rkang pas dag par bya ba dang*/ nyi ma rkang pas dag par bya ba dang*/ nyi rkang rags pa le lo can dang*/ nyi mas zla ba dag par bya ba dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ byed pa dang*/ gza' skar la sogs pa'i ming rgyas par bshad pa'o// gnyis pa mu stegs kyi ming skar 'dod pa dgag pa la gnyis te/ 'dod pa dngos dang*/ de dgag pa'o// gsum pa lo 'pho ba dang grub pa'i mtha'i rtsis la bzhi/ lo'i 'pho ba dang*/ khyim gyi 'pho ba dang*/ nyi ma'i byed pa rtsing po dgag pa dang*/ rtsa rgyud kyis bshad pa'o// de la bdun/

lo'i nyi ma tshes kyi zhag dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ zla ba dang*/ sgra gcan dang*/ gza' lnga dang*/ thun mong gi bya ba rgyu mtshan bshad pa dang bcas pa dang*/ nyin mtshan gyi 'phel 'grib bshad pa'o// bzhi pa sgra gcan la gnyis te/ 'das pa dang*/ gdong mjug gi nges pa'o// lnga pa la gza' lnga la gsum/ spyi'i nyi ma dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa dang*/ mjug ring mdor bstan pa'o// bye brag tu bshad pa la dgu/ bkra shis la sogs pa'i longs spyod dang*/ dal ba dang*/ myur ba dang*/ gza' gzhan 'gre bar bstan pa dang*/ gza' lhag dang*/ phur bu dang*/ spa ba sangs dang*/ spen pa dang*/ gza' rnams rgyu ba'i rim pa'o// 'bras bu'i rtsis la lnga ste/ rgyu mtshan dang*/ rang gi zhing du 'thab pa'i tshul dang*/ so so'i skyes skar dang*/ zla ba'i ltas dang*/ sgra gcan nyi zlar 'jug pa'i tshul lo/// /gsum pa go la bshad pa la lnga/ nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i go la mdor bstan pa/ mu stegs kyi 'dod pa sun dbyung ba dang*/ gza' 'khor ba'i go la'i tshul/ thun mong gi go la bshad pa/ nyi ma'i rgyu ba rgyas bshad do// de la bcu gcig ste/ lho byang du rgyu ba'i nyi ma 'phel 'grib dang*/ gling thams cad kyi mnyam pa'i go la dang*/ gling so so'i bgrod pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul/ steng 'og tu 'gro ba'i tshad/ thad kar 'gro ba'i tshad/ dus bzhir 'gyur ba'i nges pa/ snang mun gyi tshad/ phyogs ngos bzung ba/ dus kyi nges pa/ khyim dang gza'i 'khor lugs/ dus sbyor bcu gnyis bstan pa'o// bzhi pa dbu ma'i dbugs la gza' dang skye ba'i rkang pa bstan pa la brgyad de/ rkang pa'i gzhi dbu ma'i rlung bstan pa dang*/ dal myur gyi rkang pa dngos dang*/ du ba'i longs spyod dang*/ gza' lnga'i dkyil 'khor bsdu ba/ go sla dang bcas pa dang*/ rgyu skar dang du ba'i byed pa dang*/ gza' lnga'i nus pa dang*/ nyi zla'i bshad pa dang*/ chags 'jig bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum/ ye shes kyi rlung ngos bzung ba dang*/

gza' brgyad kyis 'khor ba'i tshad/ stong par 'jug tshul lo// gnyis pa rkang pa dngos la brgyad/ thun mong gi bshad pa/ bye brag tu bkra shis dang*/ lhag pa dang*/ phur bu dang*/ spa ba sangs dang*/ spen pa rnams kyi myur rkang dang*/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad kyis dal rkang dang*/ gza' lnga'i khyim gsum longs spyod la nyi ma dang mthun pa'i dbyug gu'o// gsum pa du ba'i longs spyod la gsum/ sgra gcan dang mthun pa'i longs spyod dang*/ nyi ma dang mthun pa'i longs spyod chu tshod chu srang bstan pa dang*/ du ba'i lhag ma'i longs spyod do// bzhi pa gza' lnga'i dkyil 'khor bsdu ba go sla dang bcas pa la gnyis/ lo dang*/ nyin zhag bstan pa dang*/ go sla tshigs bcad gnyis kyis skyes skar gyi don du sbyang ba bstan pa'o// bdun pa nyi zla bshad pa la gsum/ rkang pa dang*/ 'dzin pa'i tshad dang*/ gzhan du go bar bya ba bstan pa'o// brgyad pa chags 'jig bstan pa la bdun/ dus bzhi'i mthar gza' stong par 'jug pa'i tshul dang*/ dus bzhi ngos bzung dang*/ rtsod pa bstan pa tshes dang gza'i long sa spyod bstan pa/ ye shes rlung gi cha'i dbyangs bstan pa/ de nyid ltar sbyar ba/ don 'di gzhan gyis shes dka' bar bstan pa'o// bcu pa dbyangs 'char ba dang 'khrul 'khor gyi mdor bsdus la gnyis/ gnas pa gsum gyi dngos dang*/ gnas pa lngas gzhung don go sla bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum ste/ dbyangs 'char ba la sogs pa dang*/ sgra gcan gyi stobs dang*/ sgyogs la sogs pa'o// dang po la brgyad de/ dbyangs 'char ba 'bras bu dang bcas pa dang*/ 'dri tshig gi dang*/ dbugs kyi ltas dang*/ gza' skar gyi stobs dang*/ gdengs ka'i 'khor lo dang*/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad kyis tshe'i tha ma'i 'bras bu dang*/ rten 'brel zla khyim dang*/ sbyar ba'i dang*/ 'bras bu gnyis kyis rten 'brel gyi brtsis dang*/ phyogs kyi stobs dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi ba rtsis so// dang po dbyangs 'char la bcu gcig ste/

dbyangs kyi ngo bo bshad pa dang*/ tshes dang gza' la sbyar ba dang*/ 'bras rtsis dang*/ mdo rgyas kyi lo zla tshes la dbyangs 'char nub bstan pa/ ring thung gi sgo nas rgyas bshad/ brtan g.yo'i dus sbyor bshad pa/ yud tsam dang chu tshod la sogs pa la dbyangs 'char ba'i rim pa/ dbyangs gza' dang sbyar ba/ dus sbyor la 'char ba/ 'byung ba la 'char ba/ de rnams kyi don bsdu ba'o// 'dri tshig dang dbugs kyi ltas la bzhi/ 'byung ba so so'i dus la dris pa'i dge mi dge dang*/ pho nyas dris pa'i ltas dang/ lo la sogs pa'i bye brag brjod pa/ dbugs 'byung 'jug gi 'bras bu'o// gza' skar stobs la gsum/ dus sbyor la gza' 'char ba'i 'bras bu dang*/ gza' skar dang sbyor byed kyi dge mi dag /skar ma'i stobs so// gnyis pa sgra gcan gyi stobs la bdun/ 'bri ti dang drag po/ thun phyed pa'i sgra gcan gyi stobs ming stobs gsum dang*/ rgyal mtshan du ba la sogs kyi stobs mi bden par bstan pa/ rtsa ba'i sgra gcan gyi stobs/ de'i 'bras bu/ zhar la tshes kyi sgra gcan bstan zhing bsngags pa'o// gsum pa sgyogs la sogs pa bstan pa la gnyis te/ rtsod par byed pa'i 'khrul 'khor dang*/ zhar las byung ba'o// dang po la dgu ste/ sgyogs bca' ba dang*/ 'phang thabs gnyis kyis rdzong gzhig pa dang*/ rdzong bshig pa'i gru'i thabs dang*/ me sgyogs dang*/ chu gri'i 'khor lo dang*/ rlung gi 'khor lo dang*/ rdo rje gur dang*/ lcags mda' dang ral gri'i 'khor lo dang*/ shing rta'i 'khrul 'khor ro// zhar byung la bzhi/ bsil kha brtseg ma dang*/ khyogs kyi rtsed mo dang*/ chu gyen la drang ba'i thabs dang*/ de rnams gang gi phyir bya ba bstan pa'o// gnas pa lnga'i gzhung go sla bstan pa la lnga/ chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba dum bu bcu gnyis bskor tshul dang*/ kla klo nyams shing sangs rgyas kyi chos dar bar byed pa dang*/ sems can la phan pa ster ba'i tshul/

'jam dpal dang spyan ras gzigs snga phyir nges pa dang*/ rtsod pa'i mthar bde bar gyur pa'i tshul lo// dang po la gsum/ mdor bstan dang*/ gling rgyas bshad/ dum bu bcu gnyis bskor tshul lo// gnyis pa la drug khyab 'jug gi 'jug pa brgyad dang drag po bshad pa/ kla klo'i 'byung tshul/ de'i spyod pa dang*/ ye shes 'jug pa'i tshul/ rtsod pa 'byung ba'i rim pa/ kla klo ji ltar 'joms pa'i tshul lo// bzhi pa la gsum/ kal ki ji tsam bzhugs pa'i tshad/ yun ji tsam bde bar 'gyur ba/ mjug bsdu ba'o// lnga pa la gnyis/ 'jug pa'i dus kyi tshad/ phyi'i dus dang bstan pa'i sbyar bshad do// le'u dang po'i bsdus don no/// /nang gi le'u 'grel pa dang bcas pa la gnyis te/ mtshams sbyar ba dang*/ gzhung gi don no// dang po la gsum/ mchod brjod bshad par ma bca' ba/ gleng bslang ba'o// gzhung don la gnyis/ zhus pa dang*/ lan no// lan la mdor bsdus bdun las/ mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad do// de la dang po lus sems dang bden pa'i gnas lugs mdor bsdus la gnas pa bdun te/ mngal du skye ba bsdu ba dang*/ khams drug las grub pa dang*/ skye ba'i rim pas khu khrag dang kun gzhi sbyor ba dang*/ khyab 'jug gi 'jug pa dang sbyar ba dang*/ zla ba re rer skye ba'i rim pa dang*/ sku bzhi dang rdo rje bzhi sbyar bshad dang*/ mngon par byang chub pa bzhi dang*/ rtsa rlung thig le bshad pa'o// zla ba re rer skye ba'i rim pa la bzhi/ zla ba bdun so sor skye ba'i rim pa/ rtsa dang tshigs chags pa'i tshul/ zhar la sdug bsngal gyi bden pa dang*/ lam gyi bden pa bstan pa'o// lnga pa sku bzhi rdo rje bzhi sbyar bshad la bzhi/ kun 'byung dag pa'i sku dang*/ bye brag mngal gyi gnas skabs su sku bzhir bshad/ dbugs dang sbyar bshad/ rdo rje bzhir sbyar ba'o// bdun pa rtsa rlung la sogs pa bshad pa la bcu ste/ 'byung ba'i rang bzhin gyi rten dang*/

brten pa bshad pa 'byung ba las khams skye bar bstan pa gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i 'grel pa dang*/ khams dang phung po drug ldan bstan pa dang*/ bye brag dbang po'i gzung 'dzin dang*/ khams drug gi rnam dag bshad pa/ khams las las kyi dbang po 'byung ba dang*/ khams drug la rlung drug 'byung ba dang*/ khams la rtsa dang tshigs 'byung ba dang*/ khams las sor mo dang skra spu 'byung ba'i tshul lo// gnyis pa kun 'byung la sogs pa bstan pa'i mdor bsdus bzhi ste/ rten dang brten pa bshad pa dang*/ thabs shes rab dang*/ khams kyi bye brag dang*/ phyi nang mtshungs par bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum/ 'khor lo dang sku bzhi rten dang brten pa dang*/ 'khor lo dang rigs drug dang*/ snyigs ma'i rtsa dang rigs rten dang rten par bstan pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ lus dang bsam pa'i dbye ba dang*/ phan tshun 'khyud pa thabs shes rab tu bstan pa'o// gsum pa la gnyis te/ rtsa khams 'phel 'grib kyi rim pa/ mu stegs dang bstun nas rang bzhin skyes bu sbyar bshad do// bzhi pa phyi nang mtshungs par bstan pa la gsum ste/ mtshan nyid mtshungs pa dang*/ rlung dus dang mtshungs pa dang*/ rtsa bshad pa'o// dang po la drug 'byung ba dang*/ dus dang*/ gza' nang du sbyar ba dang*/ don snod dang lus zungs bdun la sbyar bshad dang*/ 'byung po'i skye gnas la sogs sbyar ba/ ri dang mtsho dang gling dang srid gsum nang du sbyar ba dang*/ me gsum nang du sbyar ba dang*/ gza' la sogs pa dang*/ rtsa rnams grangs mtshungs par bshad pa'o// gnyis pa rlung bshad pa la drug /phyi'i dus sbyor lte ba'i 'khor lo sbyar ba/ 'pho ba'i sbyar bshad/ dkyil 'khor lnga'i lhag pa'i lha bshad pa/ rlung bcu gang na gnas pa bstan pa/ rlung rgyu tshul/ rlung gi las bshad pa'o// gsum pa rtsa bshad pa la lnga/ mu stegs dang mthun pa'i ming*/ phyogs skyong dang mthun par sbyar ba/ 'khor lo drug gi rang bzhin/ snar dkyil 'khor lnga rgyu tshul/

zhing la sogs pa'i sbyar bshad do// gsum pa nang gi rtsod pa dang*// dbu ma las rgyud thams cad 'byung ba'i mdor bsdus la gsum/ rtsod pa nang du sbyar ba dang*/ rgyud thams cad 'byung tshul dang*/ khams las lha nyid skye ba bstan pa'o/ dang po la gnyis/ 'khor los bsgyur ba dang kla klo nang du bstan pa dang*/ byang chub kyi lam du bshad pa'o// gnyis pa la drug ste/ ye shes kyi rlung la rigs sum cu rtsa drug 'byung ba dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi lha dang*/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud kyi nges pa dang*/ 'dus pa'i dbye ba drug dang*/ phyi nang gi rgyas gdab dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i lha'i sbyar bshad do/ de la brgyad de/ sangs rgyas dang*/ nus ma dang lha mo'i sbyar bshad snying po'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ gsung gi lha mo dang*/ tshes kyi lha dang*/ dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi lha dang*/ bye brag nyung ngu'i lha dang*/ lha rnams rtsa la sbyar ba dang*/ nad bskyed pa'i rtsa rgyas bshad do// bzhi pa 'chi ltas mdor bstan pa la rlung dang rtsa dang khams kyi 'chi ltas la bdun te/ g.yon zla ba'i 'chi ltas/ g.yas nyi ma'i 'chi ltas/ nyi zla'i nges pa/ dus su 'chi ba'i nges pa/ rtsa chad pa'i 'chi ltas/ dus rtsa dang nyi zla'i rgyu ba chad dang bcas pa'i nges pa dang*/ khams 'gyur ba'i 'chi ltas so// dang po la gsum/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ nges pa bstan pa'o// nyi ma'i 'chi ltas la bdun/ lnga tshan du 'phel ba dang*/ rnam grangs rgyas bshad dang*/ 'dab ma mdor bstan pa dang*/ re'u mig bstan pa dang*/ mu stegs kyi 'dod pa dgag pa dang*/ rang gi 'dod pa dang*/ rgyas bshad do// gsum pa nyi zla'i nges pa la gnyis/ rlung lhag pa 'chi ltas su 'gyur ba'i nges pa/ steng 'og gi nges pa'o// bzhi pa dus su 'chi ba'i nges pa la lnga/ rlung rdzogs pas 'chi ba'i mtshan nyid/ dbugs 'phel ba'i rim pa/ chu srang 'phel ba/ chu tshod 'phel ba/ zhag 'phel ba'i nges pa'o// lnga pa rtsa chad pa la dgu/

mdor bstan dang*/ las kyi 'khor lo 'dor ba/ rtsa'i yi ge mdor bstan pa/ 'khor lo bstan pa/ las kyi 'khor lo'i yi ge bshad pa/ lhag pa'i dbugs kyi yi ge bshad pa/ 'khor lo'i chad bshad pa/ nyi zla'i shol nang du sbyar ba/ nyin re bzhin rtsa chad pa'i nges pa'o// drug pa dus rtsa dang nyi zla'i rgyu ba chad dang bcas pa'i nges pa la dgu/ dug gis phog na 'chi ba'i nges pa/ zla ba'i rkang pa rtsa la sbyar ba/ 'khor lo'i nges pa/ dus tshigs kyi gnas/ 'khor lo'i 'dab ma la dbyangs sbyar ba/ nyi ma gsal byed la longs spyod pa/ nyi zla'i dag pa bstan pa/ dbugs la sogs pa'i sbyar bshad/ dpa' bo cig pa'i nges pa'o// bdun pa khams 'gyur ba'i 'chi ltas la gsum/ khams 'gyur ba dang*/ nye ba'i ltas dang*/ 'chi ba bslu ba'o// lnga pa 'jig rten kun rdzob tu skye ba dang 'gag pa bstan pa'i mdor bsdus la dgu ste/ thig le 'dzin pa dang*/ 'dor ba'i khyad par dang*/ thig le dang kun gzhi gnas lugs/ de las byung ba'i kun 'byung bstan pa/ rang gi 'chi ba dpe dang bcas pa/ sa la sogs pa brgyad kyi rang bzhin/ de dbyangs lnga dang gza' la sbyar bshad/ sems can gyi las bshad pa/ zhar la grub mtha' gzhan spang ba'i tshul/ bye brag tu mi rnams kyi skye 'chi bstan pa'o// sems can gyi las bshad pa la brgyad/ las bshad pa dngos dang*/ byed pa po med par 'bras bu yod pa dang*/ 'dod pas srid par sbyor ba dang*/ bde sdug gi rgyu mtshan dang*/ de ston pa la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ 'chi kha'i las bstan pa/ mtho ris dang ngan song gi dbye ba 'chi ba'i rgyu bshad pa'o// zhar la grub mtha' gzhan spang ba'i tshul la bdun/ log pa'i lam spong ba dang*/ yang dag pa'i lam bstan pa'i phan yon/ sangs rgyas dang mu stegs dang kla klo'i ye shes skye ba'i dus/ spyod pa bstan pa/ 'byung po'i chos lugs rgyas bshad/ gar skye'i rtags/ bag chags kun gzhi la 'jog pa'i nges pa'o// bye brag tu mi'i skye 'chi bstan pa la bdun/

skye 'chi dbyangs dang sbyar ba mdor bstan pa/ gsal byed la sogs rgyas bshad/ skyes pa bud med kyi khams 'phel ba'i rim pa/ dbu ma'i rlung sdud pa rkang pa dang sbyar bshad/ lo brgya dang lo gsum zla phyed gsum gyi nges pa/ rkang pa dang sbyar ba'i nges pa/ 'chi ba'i nges pa bshad pa'o// drug pa bcud kyi len la sogs pa dang*/ byis pa'i rgyud mdor bstan pa la drug ste/ lus bsrung ba mdor bstan dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam bstan pa dang*/ nad zhi ba'i thabs dang*/ gser dngul gyi bzo dang*/ spos sbyor dang*/ byis pa gso ba'o// gsum pa la gnyis te/ rnal 'byor gyis bya ba dang*/ phal pa'o/ dang po la gnyis/ nad zhi bar bya ba dang*/ bcud kyi len no// dang po la bcu bzhi ste/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i rlung sbyor/ 'du ba bzhi sel ba'i rlung sbyor/ lto ba'i nad bsal ba/ rtsa bcing pa'i 'chi bslu/ rgyab kyi gzer nad bsal ba/ bad kan dang chu 'gags sel ba/ mig nad sel ba/ ma zhu ba sel ba/ 'bras nad sel ba/ so srin sel ba/ mdze nad sel ba/ srog rtsol gyi nyes dmigs/ phyag rgya dang bza' ba'i nges pa/ a ba dhu ti pa'i sman no// bcud len la gsum/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ snar blugs pa dang*/ sha lnga'i bcud len no// phal pa yis bya ba la gnyis te/ nad zhi bar bya ba dang*/ bcud len no// dang po la bzhi/ rlung nad la sogs sel ba'i ro sbyor dang*/ thang gis nad bsal ba la sogs pa thams cad la sbyar ba/ 'khrul 'khor dang*/ sman dang*/ sngags kyis 'brum nad gso ba dang*/ tshad pas gdungs pa zhi bar bya ba'o// bcud len la gnyis/ rin po che'i bcud len dang*/ zas dang spyod lam mo// bzhi pa gser dngul bya ba la gnyis/ gser phyed 'gyur dang*/ dngul 'gyur ro// lnga pa spos sbyor la gnyis te/ spos sbyor dang*/ dri btso ba'o// dang po la bdun/ spos sbyor gyi re'u mig tsha'i tshad/ spos reng bya thabs/ khrus kyi spos kyi re'u mig

dril phyes re'u mig mar khu dang sbyar ba'i re'u mig mjug bsdu ba'o// dri btso ba la bcu ste/ lha dang sde tshan nam slas dbye ba/ btso ba'i cho ga bslang ba'i thabs/ 'bras bu'i 'tshed pa/ 'dab ma dang/ ngang pa'i 'tshed pa/ khyogs kyi 'tshed pa/ tshig na bsil bar bya ba dang*/ khrus kyi sbyor ba/ sen rkogs kyis dri blang ba/ me tog dri bsgo ba/ til sbyangs te dri bsgo ba'o// drug pa byis pa gso ba bstan pa la gnyis/ mngal nad bcos pa dang*/ cho ga bstan pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ mngal rengs zhi ba'i don du sum cu rtsa bzhi pa'i 'khor lo bstan pa/ byis pa la 'tshe ba'i ma mo/ de ni gnod pa'i dus dang rgyu/ nad gso ba rgyas bshad do// cho ga la dgu/ zhag gi rnal 'byor ma'i cho ga zla ba'i rnal 'byor ma dang*/ lo'i rnal 'byor ma'i cho ga dang*/ ma mo bzung ba'i mtshan nyid/ 'chi ba'i ltas/ zhi ba'i don du dkyil 'khor bstan pa/ thab dang phyag mtshan dgod pa dang*/ khrus kyi cho ga'o// bdun par rang bzhin gyi lta ba bstan pa'i mdor bsdus la gsum/ mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba dang*/ rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' dang*/ sems can 'dod pa'i chos la bzhag pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas pa bshad pa'o// de la gsum/ sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' dang*/ phyi rol pa'i khyad par dang*/ phyogs snga ma bstan pa dang*/ mi 'thad pa sun phyung zhing 'dod pa bstan pa'o// phyogs snga la drug tshangs pas bstan pa rig byed kyi gzhung lugs dang*/ khyab 'jug gi klu'i grub mtha' dang*/ dbang phyug zhi ba'i grub mtha' dang*/ rgyang 'phen pa'i dang*/ kla klo'i 'dod pa dang*/ gcer bu pa'i grub mtha' bem po srog yod bstan pa'o// mi 'thad pa sun dbyung zhing rang gi 'dod pa bstan pa la drug tshangs pa khyab 'jug gi grub mtha' dgag pa/ dbang phyug pa dgag pa/ zhar la rang gi nyan thos la sogs pa'i phyogs 'dzin dgag cing mtha' bral du bstan pa/

kla klo'i 'dod pa dgag pa/ rgyang 'phen dgag pa/ gcer bu pa dgag pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ sgra rtsol byung gi gtan tshigs kyis rigs byed rang byung dgag rigs byed bram ze kho nas 'don na thams cad la khyab pa dang*/ rigs kyi spyod pa dgag pa/ mchod sbyin gyis grol ba dgag pa'o// gnyis pa dbang phyug pa dgag pa la drug thams cad kyi byed pa po las la ltos pas dbang phyug tu mi 'thad pa dang*/ 'byung ba dang mtshungs pa'i rgyu dbang phyug tu mi 'thad pa dang*/ kun rdzob rten 'brel gyi rigs pa dang*/ byas pa'i gtan tshigs kyis sgra rtag pa dgag pa/ rgyu mi dmigs pas 'bras bu mi dmigs pa dang*/ bdag tu 'gro ba dgag pa'o// rten 'brel rigs pa la bzhi ste/ phan tshun rten 'brel dang*/ rgyu 'bras rten 'brel rtag pa dang*/ de'i rgyus rgyu la dbang phyug tu 'khrul pa dgag pa dang*/ lung gis grub pa'i mi 'thad pa dang*/ mtshungs pa'i rigs pa'o// byas pa'i gtan tshigs kyis sgra rtag pa dgag pa la gnyis/ dam bcas 'gog pa dang*/ rtags ma grub pas 'gog pa'o// zhar la rang gi nyan thos la sogs pa'i phyogs 'dzin dgag cing mtha' bral du bstan pa la bzhi/ spyir chos thams cad bdag med du bstan pa/ bye brag tu smra ba'i gang zag dgag pa/ mdo sde pa'i phyi rol gyi don rnam pa gtod byed dgag pa/ sems tsam dgag pa'o// de la lnga/ phyogs lnga dang*/ rnam shes mdor bstan dang*/ rgol lan rgyas bshad kyis gzhan dbang sun dbyung ba dang*/ skad cig ma dgag pa dang*/ mtha' bral du bstan pa'o// gcer bu pa dgag pa la gsum/ srog lus kyi tshad lus kyi tshad tsam rtag par 'dod pa dgag srog gi thar pa dgag /bye brag srog can dgag pa'o// sems can 'dod pa'i chos la bzhag pa la bzhi ste/ thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul du bstan pa/ don gyi blang dor brtag pa sangs rgyas kyi rnam 'phrul bstan pa/ nyi ma'i shing rtas bstod pa'o// nang gi le'u ste gnyis pa'i bsdus don no// dbang gi le'u 'grel pa dang bcas pa la gnyis/

mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba dang*/ gzhung gi don no// de la mdor bsdus drug las/ dang po rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ de'i bya ba bstan pa'i mdor bsdus la bzhi/ gleng bslang dang*/ zhus pa dang*/ dgos pa'i dbye ba dang*/ lan no// de la bcu ste/ slob dpon dang*/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid dang*/ gnas dang dus bstan pa dang*/ sa brtag pa dang sbyin bsreg gi don du thab khung la sogs pa dang*/ bum pa dang*/ dus dang*/ dgang gzar la sogs pa'i yo byad dang*/ las bsgrub pa dang*/ mchod pa dang las sbyor bstan pa'o// dang po la lnga/ bla ma'i mtshan nyid/ slob dpon gdug pa can gyi skyon/ de brgal lan gyis rgyas bshad/ grangs nges kyi dbye bas shin du rgyas bshad/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid do// gnyis pa la bzhi/ dus mdor bstan/ mngon byung gi nges pa/ dus der dbang dang rab gnas bya ba'i tshul/ 'byor ldan dang kun spangs la ji ltar sbyin pa'i rim pa'o// gsum pa sa brtag pa la lnga/ sa brtag pa dngos dang*/ rigs dang mthun pa'i sa'i mtshan nyid/ las kyi dbye ba/ mtshan nyid mi ldan na rdzas kyi sbyang ba/ sa'i phyogs bstan pa'o// bzhi pa sbyin sreg gi don du thab khung la sogs bshad pa la bzhi/ thabs kyi dbyibs/ mtshan ma/ tshad/ phur bu'i mtshan nyid do// lnga pa bum pa la gnyis/ rgyu dang*/ chag tshad do// drug pa dus la gnyis/ las bsgrub pa'i dus dang*/ mi shes pa spang ba'o// bdun pa dgang gzar la sogs pa'i yo byad la bcu/ sbyin sreg gi bsreg rdzas gdan gting ba'i phyogs/ rdul tshon mchod yon gyi snod/ dgang gzar blug gzar/ lha'i rnal 'byor rdul tshon gyi rnam dag thig skud kyi tshad do// brgyad pa las bsgrub tshul la gnyis/ 'dug stangs dang*/ bgrang phreng ngo*// dgu pa mchod pa la bdun/ me tog /spos/ lta bshos/ byug pa/ mar me/ mchod yon gyi 'bru/ spyi'i kha dog go /bcu pa las sbyor la lnga/ 'khrul 'khor bri ba'i cho ga

bkri tshul/ bzhag pa/ phyir bri ba'i gzugs/ mjug bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ sa la sogs pa bzung ba'i mdor bsdus la gsum/ gnas skabs kyi mchod brjod dang*/ 'brel dang*/ gzhung gi don no// de la gnyis te/ rgyud las gsungs pa dang*/ sngags kha bskong ba bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ sa'i cho ga dang*/ slob ma bsrung zhing thig skud la sogs pa lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o// dang po la bcu gcig ste/ lus la rdo rje dgod pa dang*/ bgegs bsreg pa dang*/ gtor ma btang ba dang*/ rdo rje shugs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis khro bcu spro ba dang*/ zad par yul dang*/ phyogs skyong*/ gza' dang*/ klu dang*/ 'byung po spro ba dang*/ de rnams kyi mjug bsdud dang*/ gtor ma'i cho ga'i sngags so// sa chog la drug lha mo spyan drang ba/ mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa/ spyir gsol 'debs kyi tshig /sa brko ba'i mtshan ma/ sa sbyang ba'i nyi ma/ gza' dang dus nges pa bstan pa'o// slob ma bsrung zhing thig skud la sogs pa lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga la drug slob ma bsrung ba dang*/ thig skud mdor bstan dang*/ ltas dang ngan pa bzlog pa dang*/ me rlung gi re kha spang ba dang*/ thig skud dang*/ tshon gyi dmigs pa'o// gnyis pa sngags kyi kha bskang ba la lnga/ sngon 'gro dang*/ lhag gnas dang*/ dbang dang*/ bzlas pa'i sngags dang*/ zhar la thig mdor bstan no// dang po la brgyad/ khrus sngags/ rigs drug dgod pa/ lag pa sbyang ba'i sngags/ cho ga'i sngags/ bsrung 'khor gyi sngags mchod pa'i lha mo'i sngags/ yan lag bdun gyi rnal 'byor/ gtor ma sbyang ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o// lhag gnas kyi sngags la bcu gsum ste/ sa'i lha mo dang*/ bdud la snun pa/ phur bus gdab pa/ lta stangs dang*/ bum pa'i sngags/ thig skud kyi sngags/ rdul tshon/ rdo rje dril bu dang*/ so shing gi sngags dang*/ bsrung ba'i sngags dang*/ ku sha'i stan sbyin pa dang*/

rmi lam brtag pa dang*/ ngan pa bzlog pa'i cho ga dang sngags so// dbang gi la dgu ste/ spyan drang ba dang*/ dmigs pa dang*/ byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang gi don du gsol 'debs kyi sngags/ nga rgyal gyi sngags dang*/ dbang gong ma'i gsol 'debs kyi sngags dang*/ bdag 'jug dang bdag po'i dbang gi gsol 'debs dang*/ blang ba dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal gyi sngags so// de la lnga/ nga rgyal gyi sngags dngos/ phyag rgya phyag mtshan/ glang lpags/ klu bcu dgod pa'i sngags so// bzlas sngags la bzhi ste/ rkang pa bcu drug pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro dra ba'i sngags dang*/ phreng ba'i sngags dang*/ bzlas pa dang*/ sbyin bsreg nges pa'o// zhar la thig mdor bstan pa la gsum/ thig skud mchod de gdab pa dang*/ de bshad pa dang*/ lhag pa dbyi ba'o// gsum pa dkyil 'khor bri ba'i mdor bsdus la gsum/ phyag 'tshal zhing thig mdor bstan pa dang*/ gzhung gi don dang*/ slob dpon slob ma'i bya ba'o// gzhung la gsum/ thig dang tshon bkye ba dang*/ sa bon dgod pa'o// dang po la bcu bdun te/ tshangs thig dang*/ zur thig dang*/ spyi'i rnam bzhag dang*/ spros med kyi thig 'khor lo gsum gyi tshad/ gtso bo'i gdan dang*/ pad ma dang rdo rje'i phreng ba dang*/ ka ba la sogs pa dang*/ rdo rje ra ba dang*/ bum pa'i gnas dang*/ spang chen spang chung dang*/ phyi rol dang*/ mjug bsdu ba/ rta babs kyi thig dang*/ gsung gi dang*/ sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi thig cha dang*/ khor yug gi tshad do// gnyis pa tshon la gnyis te/ bri ba dang skyon yon dbye ba'o// dang po la dgu/ rdul tshon gyi rgyu/ phyogs kyi kha dog mchod yon la sogs pa'i dang*/ nang dang rta babs la sogs pa'i kha dog dang*/ snam bu'i kha dog dang*/ re khā dang*/ klu dang nyi zla dgod pa dang*/ rta babs kyi mtshan ma dang*/ rgyan bstan pa'o// skyon yon bstan pa la brgyad/ bri nyes pa'i skyon/ mtshan ma'i nges pa/ lhag pa'i skyon/

rdul tshon mtho dman/ phyi'i dag pa dang*/ steng 'og dang*/ nang gi dag pa sbyar ba/ rtsa rgyud kyi nges pa/ go sla bshad pa'o// gsum pa sa bon la gsum/ mdor bstan stong pa lnga'i sngags/ rgyas bshad do// de la nyi shu ste/ bdam ka bstan pa dang*/ nang gi pad ma dang*/ rim pa gnyis pa dang*/ sangs rgyas yab yum dang*/ skye mched kyi lha dang*/ sgo skyong dang gdan gyi nges pa dang*/ pad ma'i sa bon dang*/ mchod lha dang*/ 'dod ma mi 'dod ma dang bcas pa dang*/ tsar tsi ka la sogs pa dang*/ de'i 'dab ma'i dang*/ sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi bden bral la sogs pa dang*/ phyogs skyong gi nang tshan gyi sa bon dang*/ ring thung gi dbye ba dang*/ sgo ba dang*/ klu'i rgyal po dang*/ dur khrod kyi lha mo dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ rta babs kyi mtshan ma'o// slob dpon slob ma'i bya ba la gnyis te/ bya ba bstan pa dang*/ las kyi rdo rje'o// bzhi pa dbang bskur ba'i mdor bsdus la lnga ste/ sbyin sreg dang*/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ slob ma dkyil 'khor du bzhugs pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ phyag 'tshal zhing bshad par dam bca' ba dang*/ sbyin bsreg go /de la gnyis/ thab khung dang*/ dngos so// dang po la bzhi/ thab kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ tshad/ slob dpon gyi gdan/ thab kyi mtshan nyid rgyas bshad do// sbyin bsreg dngos la dgu/ sngon du bya ba/ las so so'i me lha rgyas bshad/ me spar ba spyan drang ba/ mchod yon dbul ba/ me'i dbye ba/ lce bdun gyi dbye ba/ dgang blugs med na the bong gis bya ba/ rdzas dbul ba'o// de la lnga/ yam shing 'bul ba/ 'bru la sogs pa dang*/ mar dang*/ dri spos byin la gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ ye shes lha'i sbyin sreg shugs la bstan pa'o// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad do// de la bdun/ bum pa bsgrub pa/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa/ ye shes dgug gzhug

mchod pa 'bul ba/ maṇ+ḍal bya ba/ zhar la rdul tshon la me tog mi dor ba'i nges pa/ sngags dang mchod pa'i rim pa'o// de la lnga/ sngags kyi nges pa/ dgug gzhug gi sngags/ las chen mtha' bsgyur gyi sngags/ dkyil 'khor kha dog gi rnam dag rigs drug gi sa bon rnam bcu dbang ldan dang bcas pa'o// gsum pa mchod pa la gnyis/ mchod pa spyir bstan dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa'o// de la bcu/ dkon mchog dang*/ sku lnga dang*/ rdo rje bzhi dang*/ rnam thar dang*/ thugs dang*/ gsung dang*/ sku'i 'khor lo dang*/ dur khrod kyi lha dang*/ bla ma dang*/ mjug bsdu ba'o// bzhi pa slob ma gzhug pa la drug ste/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ rigs drug gi dam tshig gzung ba dang*/ so shing dor ba dang*/ skyor chu blud pa dang*/ ye shes dbab pa dang*/ babs nas ji ltar bya ba'o// de la dgu/ babs pa'i mtshan nyid/ byed las/ yum babs pa'i byed las/ skye mched babs pa/ de dag gi nges pa/ bsrung zhing brtan par bya ba/ brtul zhugs sbyin pa/ gdong bcing ba/ me tog dor zhing spyan dbye ba'o// lnga pa dbang bskur ba la bzhi/ bum pa dang sman gyi nges pa/ dbang bskur ba dngos/ don bshad pa/ dam tshig bshad pa'o// dang po la drug bum ba'i grangs/ bum sman gyi re'u mig sman dang 'bru cha dbye/ rin po che gang du gzhug pa'i dbye ba/ mjug bsdu ba/ zhar la me tog dor ba dang*/ spyan dbye ba'i sngags bstan pa'o// dbang la bzhi ste/ byang phyogs su chu dang cod pan gyi dbang*/ lhor dar dpyangs dang*/ rdo rje dril bu'i dbang*/ shar du brtul zhugs dang ming gi dbang*/ nub tu rjes gnang gi dbang ste bdun no// don bshad pa la bdun/ dam tshig mdor bstan/ dbang thob pa'i dus bshad pa/ gzhan 'dod bstan pa/ dam tshig sgra ji bzhin bshad pa/ nges don la sbyar ba/ dbang gi rnam dag /dbang gi 'bras bu'o// dam tshig bshad pa la gsum/ ltung ba dag pa'i tshad/ bye brag lci yang bstan pa/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi rgyas par bshad pa'o// lnga pa rab gnas dbang gong ma tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa rnal 'byor ma'i spyod pa bstan pa'i mdor bsdus la lnga ste/

rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang*/ sku gzugs rab gnas/ dbang gong ma/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ rnal 'byor ma'i spyod pa bstan pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ phyag 'tshal zhing dam bca' ba dang*/ slob dpon du dbang bskur ba dngos dang*/ dbang gi rnam dag dang*/ lung dang sbyar te bshad pa'o// gnyis pa sku rab gnas la bcu gnyis te/ bca' gzhi/ rten bkru zhing phyi ba/ dgab pa/ rten bskyed pa/ gnas drug byin brlabs/ ye shes dgug gzhug mnga' dbul ba/ bye brag glegs bam la sogs so sor bskyed chog sa bon dgod pa/ snga phyir ji ltar bya ba/ khron pa dang bskyed mos tshal rab gnas/ yon phul la smon lam gdab pa'o// gsum pa dbang gong ma la gsum/ rten phyag rgya brtag pa dang*/ rab tu byed pa dang*/ bskur ba'i rim pa'o// de la drug bum dbang gsang dbang*/ shes rab ye shes/ de dag gi rnam dag lung gis bshad pa/ go cha rgyas bshad do// de la drug gsol ba gdab pa/ phyag rgya dgod pa/ bum pa dang phyag rgya'i grangs/ ji ltar bskur ba/ sdom pa sbyin pa/ bde ba chen po'i don bshad pa'o// de la brgyad/ dga' ba'i rab tu dbye ba/ phyag rgya ngan pa spang ba/ dga' ba'i rim pa/ de gnas skabs bzhis dbye ba/ sku bzhi'i dbye ba/ phyag rgya'i rnam dag rigs gsum gyi dbye ba/ 'dzag med bstan pa'o// bzhi pa tshogs kyi 'khor lo la drug ste/ snod ma yin pa gshegs pa dang*/ sngon 'gro/ rigs sum cu so drug gi rnal 'byor ma dgod pa/ ma 'dzom na ji ltar bya ba/ mchod pa'i tshul/ de dag gi spyod pa/ phan yon no// lnga pa rnal 'byor ma'i spyod pa bstan pa la bcu gsum ste/ rigs sum cu so drug gi rnal 'byor ma'i rigs dang sbyar bshad/ de'i don sdud/ lha dang sbyar ba/ rnal 'byor can gyis gcig tu brten pa/ dam tshig gi mchod pa/ dri'i nges pa/ lus kyi mtshan nyid/ thabs kyi dbye ba/ rigs 'dres pa'i tshul/ bsten pa'i thabs/ yul la sbyar ba/ longs spyod bstan pa/

bza' ba la sogs par sbyar te rgyas par bshad pa'o// de la gsum/ btung ba dang*/ bza' ba'i phan yon dang nyes pa/ de la brtan nas rigs pa bshad pa'o// de la bcu gnyis/ rigs sum cu so drug dud 'gro la sbyar bshad/ mkha' spyod dang sbyar ba/ lus kyi cha shas dang sbyar ba/ sa bon dang*/ rgyud kyi nges pa/ snod phyi nang du sbyar ba/ rigs kyi rtags/ dam tshig gi rdzas lha la sbyar ba/ dam tshig rdzas dang gnas la sogs par sbyar ba/ yul thams cad na yod par bstan pa/ gnas nang du sbyar ba/ rnal 'byor ma'i rnam dag byang chub phyogs chos la sbyar ba/ gsang zhing bsgrubs na dngos grub thob par bshad pa'o// drug pa phyag rgya dang lta stangs la sogs pa bstan pa'i mdor bsdus la gnyis te/ phyag 'tshal zhing bshad par dam bca' dang*/ gzhung don no// de la gsum/ phyag rgya dang*/ brda' dang*/ bla ma mchod cing rdul tshon gshegs su gsol ba'o// dang po la brgyad de/ phyag rgya bcing ba'i don du sor mo'i ming*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ phyag rgya bzang po dang*/ khro bo'i phyag rgya dang*/ mtshan ma'i phyag rgya rdo rje la sogs pa sum cu bshad pa dang*/ cod pan la sogs pa'i rgyan gyi phyag rgya dang*/ rigs kyi phyag rgya dang*/ byol song gi gdong can gyi phyag rgya'o// gnyis pa brda' la lnga/ 'ongs pa dang lan la sogs pa'i brda' dang*/ tshar bcad pa'i brda' dang*/ 'du ba la sogs pa'i brda' dang*/ shin tu khros pa'i brda' dang*/ nges pa bshad pa'o// de la bdun/ nus pa med na lan mi bya ba dang*/ nus pa yod na brda' dang brda'i lan dang*/ mchod pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ brda' bstan mi bstan gyi nges pa'i lung*/ lta ba'i mtshan ma dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i lta stangs nyi shu dang*/ ming gi yi ge'i brda'o// gsum pa bla ma mchod pa la sogs pa la bzhi/ bla ma la drug cha dbul ba dang*/ ma phul na dngos grub mi thob par bstan pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang dang*/

rdul tshon bshags la mchod pa bya ba'o// gsum pa la gsum/ snying rje'i dbang*/ a ba dhū tī pa'i dbang*/ de 'byor ldan la bkag pa'o// bzhi pa la dgu/ gshegs su gsol ba/ rdul tshon bsdu ba/ chu bor spyan drangs ba/ stegs bu byugs te mchod pa'i rim pa/ dpa' bo'i ston mo/ tshogs kyi rab dbye/ rtsod na/ chad pas bcad pa/ gnas skabs kyi phan yon dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang thob pas rgyud thams cad kyi dbang thob par 'gyur ba'i phan yon no// dbang gi le'u ste gsum pa'i bsdus don no/// /bzhi pa la bsgrub pa'i thabs kyi le'u la gsum/ sku bzhi la phyag 'tshal ba/ bshad par dam bca' ba gzhung gi don no// de la mdor bsdus la lnga ste/ dang po gnas bsrung ba la/ sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i mdor bsdus la gnyis te/ zhus pa dang*/ lan no// lan la gnyis mtshams sbyor dang*/ lan dngos so// de la gsum/ gang bsgrub pa'i lha dang*/ gnas gang du gang gi phyir bsgrub pa dang*/ bsgrub pa'i tshul lo// de la drug bsrung ba dang*/ gdong la sogs pa dag par bya ba dang*/ tshogs bsags pa'i phyir mchod pa dang*/ sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa bdun rnam dag dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs mdor bstan rgyas bshad dang*/ rnam thar bsgom pa'o// gnyis pa sku bskyed pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi mdor bsdus la gnyis te/ rten bskyed pa dang*/ brten pa lha bskyed pa/ dang po la bzhi/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs dang*/ gdan dang*/ de dag gi sa bon dang*/ nang du sbyar bshad do// de la lnga/ gdan dang 'byung ba nang du sbyar ba/ thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la sogs 'byung ba'i nges pa/ rgya dang*/ sgo dang rta babs su sbyar ba/ chos thams cad kyis rnam dag tu sbyar ba'o/ brten pa lha bskyed pa la dgu/ mngon byang lnga las lus dang*/ lha grub pa'i tshul gtso bo yab yum bskyed pa/ nus ma bskyed pa/ thugs kyi 'khor lo bskyed pa/ bye brag tu gdan bshad pa/

mchod pa'i lha mo spro ba/ 'bras bu'i he ru kar bskyed pa bsnyen pa'i yan lag go/ gnyis pa la bzhi las/ sa bon phyag mtshan las yab bskyed pa dang*/ sku mdog dang*/ gsung dang sku'i 'khor lo// phyag mtshan/ yum gyi mtshan nyid do// gsum pa nus ma bskyed pa la gnyis/ nus ma brgyad dang rdo rje bzhi bskyed pa/ nus ma'i phyag mtshan no// bzhi pa thugs kyi 'khor lo bskyed pa la dgu mngal skyes kyi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ rgyal ba yab yum dang*/ bum pa brgyad dang*/ khro bo dang*/ skye mched kyi lha gdan dang bcas pa dang*/ thabs shes rab kyi gtso bo'i dbye ba dang*/ phyag mtshan dang*/ thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha grangs sbyar bshad dang*/ 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab la sbyar ba'o// lnga pa gsung gi 'khor lo la gsum/ phyogs mtshams su spro ba dang*/ gtso mo'i phyag mtshan dang*/ 'khor rnams kyi ming ngo*// drug pa sku'i 'khor lo la drug gtso bo 'god tshul dang*/ phyag mtshan dang*/ 'khor rnams shugs kyi 'gre bar bstan pa/ sgo skyong yab yum bskyed pa/ klu bcu dang*/ dur khrod kyi gtum mo dang*/ 'byung po bsgom pa'o// bdun pa bye brag tu gdan bshad pa la bzhi/ gsung gi lha mo'i gdan/ sku'i phyogs skyong gi gdan/ rab gtum gyi gdan/ sku'i phyogs skyong gi gdan no// brgyad pa mchod lha spro ba la gsum/ thugs dkyil 'khor gyi mchod lha dang*/ gsung gi 'dod ma spro ba dang*/ sku'i 'dod ma spro ba'o// dgu pa 'bras bu'i he ru ka bskyed pa la bsnyen pa'i yan lag dang bcas pa la bdun/ sbyang gzhi rtag mi rtag bshad pa/ sbyong byed bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan/ rten dang gdan gyi sa bon/ bde ba chen po'i dbang bskur/ lha zhu ba/ glus bskul ba dang*/ gtso bo bzhengs pa/ nga rgyal dang bcas pa'o// gsum pa las rgyal mchog gi yan lag srog dang lha bskyed pa'i mdor bsdus la gnyis/ 'grel pa byed par dam bca' ba dang*/ gzhung gi don no// de la lnga/

bskyed pa'i tshul rgyas bshad/ ye shes dgug gzhug /sa bon bstan pa/ rigs kyi 'grel pa go sla dang*/ rnam par dag pa'o// dang po la bdun te/ phyi nang gi zhu ba dang*/ glus bskul ba dngos dang*/ ldang ba'i tshul phyi nang du sbyar ba mngal skyes spro ba'i tshul bshad pa/ byis pa'i srog rlung dbang dang sbyar ba/ dbang po rgyas pa ye shes dgug pa dang sbyar ba/ bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam dbye'o// gnyis pa ye shes dgug gzhug la gsum/ ye shes gzhug pa dang*/ ro mnyam par bya ba dang*/ rgyas gdab pa'o// ro mnyam pa la lnga/ thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi ro mnyam/ sku'i sgo skyong dang*/ gsung gi ro mnyam dang*/ sku dang phyi rol gyi ro mnyam dang*/ zhar la gar dang bzhugs stangs bstan pa'o/ gsum pa sa bon la bcu gcig ste/ mtshan ma rnams kyi sa bon dang*/ des lha bskyed pa'i nges pa dang*/ rgyal ba yab yum gyi sa bon/ skye mched kyi lha dang*/ khro bo yab yum dang*/ nus ma bum pa rdo rje bzhi'i sa bon dang*/ gsung gi lha dang*/ phyogs skyong dang*/ tshes kyi lha dang*/ klu dang*/ rab gtum gyi sa bon no// bzhi pa rigs dang rigs 'grel pa go sla la la dgu/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' yab yum gyi rigs dang*/ khro bo dang*/ khro mo dang*/ phyogs skyong dang*/ rdo rje rig ma dang*/ tshes dang*/ klu dang*/ gtum mo'i rigs dang*/ mchod lha'i rigs so// lnga pa rnam par dag pa la brgyad de/ skye ba'i rim pa la sbyar ba dang*/ gnas skabs bzhi la phyi nang du sbyar ba dang*/ sku bzhi rdo rje bzhi sbyar ba dang*/ thabs shes rab tu mnyam mi mnyam dang*/ sku gsung thugs byin brlabs dang*/ zhar la rigs kyi dbye ba dang*/ stong pa nyid la sogs pa'i sbyar bshad dang*/ rtsa'i dag pa bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum mngal gyi gnas skabs la/ bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo sbyar ba dang*/ gsung dang sku la sbyar bshad dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// rtsa'i dag pa la bcu gnyis te/

'khor lo la sbyar ba/ khyim la sbyar ba/ du ba la sogs pa'i dag pa/ phung po dang khams kyi dag pa/ gsung dang sku'i lha rnams kyi dag pa/ ba spu'i dag pa/ phyag mtshan gyi dag pa/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i dag pa/ srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi dag pa/ chos sku mnyam la sogs pa bskyed pa'i dag pa/ sku bzhi'i bya ba dag pa dang*/ bzhugs stangs kyi bya ba dag pa'o// bzhi pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan pa'i mdor bsdus la gnyis/ mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba dang*/ gzhung gi don no// de la lnga/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad kyis rdzogs rims spyir bstan pa dang*/ gtum mo'i rnal 'byor dang*/ bsnyen bsgrub bzhi la sbyar ba dang*/ sbyor ba drug tu sbyar ba dang*/ lha gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ spyod pa bstan pa'o// gnyis pa la lnga/ bsgom pa'i gnas dang*/ 'bar 'dzag dang*/ ye shes bzhi'i don bshad pa dang*/ thig le dang*/ phra mo'i rnal 'byor gyi nges pa dang*/ spro bsdu'i nges pa'o// gsum pa bsnyen bsgrub la drug nang gi bzlas pa la sbyar nas rtsa rlug thig le mdor bstan dang*/ bsnyen pa dang*/ nye ba'i bsnyen pa dang*/ bsgrub pa dang*/ bsgrub pa chen po dang*/ chung ngu dang*/ chen po'i dbye ba'o// bzhi pa sbyor drug la dgu/ don dam pa'i bskyed rims kyi nges pa/ sbyor ba yan lag drug gi rab dbye/ sbyor drug gi mtshan nyid/ de'i 'bras bu/ ma grub na stobs kyi sbyor ba/ lta stangs kyi rim pa/ bskyed rdzogs kyi bsnyen bsgrub tu sbyar bshad/ srog rtsol gyi mtshan nyid/ go sla'o// lnga pa lha gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ spyod pa la sogs pa bstan pa la brgyad/ gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ phyi nang gi spyod pa dang*/ 'pho ba'i 'gros dang*/ go sla dang*/ las so so la lha'i nges pa dang*/ bdud 'dul ba'i don du rdo rje shugs bshad pa/ de'i yum bshad pa/ kha dog sna tshogs su bsgom pa phan yon dang bcas pa'o// go sla la lnga/ chags pa'i gnas skabs dag pa'i tshul/

bza' ba'i nges don/ 'khrig pa'i nges don/ phar phyin drug gi don/ phan yon no// lnga pa bsgrub pa'i thabs sna tshogs mdor bstan pa la gnyis te/ mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba dang*/ gzhung gi don to// de la bcu gnyis te/ rdo rje shugs kyi bsgrub thabs/ char dbab pa/ las tshogs bsgom pas bsgrub pa dang*/ bskyed bzlas kyi sgrub pa dang*/ zad par la sogs pa'i bsgrub pa dang*/ ro langs bsgrub pa dang*/ ming dang sngags sbyar ba dang*/ thun mong gi grub pa dang*/ bya khyung bsgrub pa dang*/ 'khrul 'khor dang*/ go sla dang*/ mngon sum dang rjes su dpag pa bsgrub pa'o// gsum pa la drug las kyi dbye bas lha'i dbye ba/ las bzhi phyogs mthun dang bcas pa'i bsam gtan/ lha bshad pa/ srog bsgrub pa'i nges pa/ ting nge 'dzin/ thabs shes rab kyi grub pa'i tshad do// bzhi pa bskyed bzlas kyis bsgrub pa la bdun/ phyag mtshan skye ba ye shes kyi sa bon/ zhi ba'i dmigs pa go sla dang bcas pa/ dgug pa dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ bskrad pa dang*/ zhe sdang la tshigs bcad gcig dang*/ rengs pa la sogs pa dang*/ bsad pa dang*/ kha dog dang*/ sa bon gyi dbye ba'o// lnga pa zad par la sogs pa la gsum/ zad par gyi bsam gtan/ dud 'gro'i 'jigs pa bsal ba/ las rnams bsgrub pa'i nges pa'o// drug pa ro langs bsgrub pa la lnga/ bsgrub pa dang*/ de'i sbyin bsreg gi thab dang*/ ji ltar bya ba dang*/ grub dus 'jigs pa spang ba/ dngos grub blang ba phan yon dang bcas pa'o// bdun pa ming dang sngags sbyar ba la bzhi/ ming la sku gsung thugs kyi lha sbyar ba/ grangs kyi tshad/ ming dang dgra grogs bstan pa/ rtsa rgyud kyi lung ngo*// de la bzhi/ sngags kyi skye ba/ dgra grogs bstan pa/ bsdebs dang*/ phan yon dang*/ dpe sgrol ma'i sngags la sbyar ba/ brgyad pa thun mong gi grub pa la bzhi/ ri lu dang*/ mig sman dang*/ spyir bsgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ bye brag ral gri bsgrub pa'o// dgu pa bya khyung bsgrub pa la gnyis te/

mche ba'i dug gso ba dang*/ dngos po/ dang po la bdun/ sbrul gyis gzung ba 'chi mi 'chi brtag pa dang*/ dug gso ba dang*/ 'byung ba yis sbyang ba dang*/ sman gyis bsal ba dang*/ rgyu ba'i dus dang*/ gza' dang sbyar bshad/ kha dog gi rigs dbye ba'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ bya khyung gi mtshan nyid/ bsgom zhing sngags bzla ba/ phan yon no// bcu pa 'khrul 'khor la drug 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i 'khrul 'khor rim pa drug pa/ ming dang yi ger dgod pa/ phyi rol gyi nges pa gshin rje mthar byed kyi 'khrul 'khor rgyas pa/ 'jam dpal gyi 'khrul 'khor bsdus pa/ de'i sngags dang kha bsgyur ro// bcu gcig pa go sla la gsum/ de kho na'i ye shes bstan pa dang*/ mchod sbyin gyi nges don dang*/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i stobs bstan pa'o// dang po la bcu gcig ste/ sgra thams cad shes par bya ba dang*/ rlung gi bcud len dang*/ srog rtsol gyi sbyor ba dang*/ tshe gzugs brtag pa dang*/ gter brtag pa dang*/ rlung gi nges pa dang*/ gtum mo'i sbyor bas dbu mar gzhug pa dang*/ 'pho ba dang*/ mkha' spyod dang*/ mngon shes bsgrub pa dang*/ mchog bsgrub pa'o// de la gsum/ snang stong 'brel ba'i tshad/ de'i don bsgom byar gdams pa/ stong pa la zhen pa dgag pa'o/ mchod sbyin gyi nges don la bzhi ste/ mchod sbyin gyi nges don dngos/ rigs byed kyi nges don/ blun pos log par go ba dgag pa/ 'dod pa'i nyes pa bshad pa'o// sbyin pa la sogs pa'i stobs bstan pa la bzhi/ sbyin pa'i phan yon/ blang dor brtag pa/ phyag rgya'i dgos pa thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor ro// dang po la lnga/ zang zing sbyin pa dang*/ phyag rgya sbyin pa dang*/ gtong ba chen po dang*/ yongs su gtong ba'i 'bras bu/ de dpes bstan pa/ sbyin pa bya ba'i tshul lo// gnyis pa la brgyad/ rig byed kyi ngag rdzun pa'i tshul/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung phan byed du bstan pa/ dkon mchog drang don du bshad pa dang*/

nges don du bstan pa dang*/ sbyin pa gnyis kyi don/ phyag rgya sbyin pa la theg dman gyi rgol ba spangs pa/ dka' thub can thams cad la bsngags shing brtse bar bya ba/ log pa'i dka' thub spang bar bstan pa'o// gsum pa la brgyad/ phyag rgya la phrog byed pa'i nyes pa/ de'i rgyu mtshan/ dpes bstan pa/ phyag rgya gsum gyi lam bstan pa/ byang sems 'ching ba dpe dang bcas pa las thams cad bsgrub pa la bsngags pa/ gzhan gyi mi 'grub par bstan pa/ ye shes kyi phyag rgyas grub par bstan pa'o// bzhi pa la gsum/ chang byin rlabs/ 'phrog ma la chang bu sbyin pa/ lhag ma'i gtor ma'o// bcu gnyis pa la mngon sum dang*/ rjes su dpag pa bstan pa la bdun/ mngon sum gyi bsgom pa spyan lnga dang bcas pa'i nges pa/ rjes dpag rnam rtog gi bsgom pa/ rtog pas bskyed rim bsgom pa/ dus kyi tshad/ las dang mthun pa'i tshogs bsags pa/ rdo rje'i tshig gi nges don no// phan yon bstan pa'o/ le'u bzhi pa bsgrub thabs kyi bsdus don no/// /lnga pa mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes grub pa bstan pa'i le'u la gsum/ mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba dang*/ gzhung dang rjes kyi don to/ dang po la lnga/ mi 'gyur ba'i dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gnyis med dang*/ sku gsum la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ rgyu mtshan dang bcas par bshad par dam bca' ba dang*/ gleng bslang ba'o// gzhung don la mdor bsdus bzhi las/ dang po rgyud rnams spro ba la sogs pa'i mdor bsdus la gnyis te/ zhus pa dang*/ lan no// de la bdun/ khams dkyil 'khor du dag pa dang*/ lus kyi dbyibs dkyil 'khor du dag pa dang*/ rigs kyi dbye ba dang thabs dang shes rab kyi rgyud dbye ba dang*/ lha rnams nang du dag pa dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir rlung dang*/ sngags bshad pa/ byang chub kyi sems sbyang ba bshad pa'o// gsum pa la lnga/ sku gsung thugs kyi rigs dbye ba/

rigs drug gi dbye ba gtsug gtor chen po'i rigs dbye ba/ rigs sum cu rtsa drug gi dbye ba/ rigs lha dang sbyar ba'o// bzhi pa thabs shes rab kyi rgyud kyi dbye ba la gnyis/ rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi don dang*/ bsam pa dang mthun par bstan pa'o// lnga pa lha rnams nang du dag pa la lnga/ nang du dag pa dngos dang*/ zhal gyi dbye ba dang*/ skye ba dang bskyed pa bsnyen bsgrub tu sbyar ba dang*/ rigs drug spro ba dang*/ de rgyud gzhan la sbyar ba'o// bzhi pa la bdun/ dpral ba nas snang bar mtha' yas kyi rigs dang*/ snying ga nas don yod dang*/ mgrin pa nas rin 'byung dang*/ lte ba nas rnam snang dang*/ gtsug gtor nas mi bskyod pa dang*/ gsang ba nas rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs spro ba dang*/ rgyas 'debs kyi rigs so// lnga pa la drug shes rab kyi rgyud sdom pa chung ba dang*/ de'i go sla dang*/ gsang 'dus rigs drug dang*/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba gsum dang*/ sdom pa rnal 'byor rje rigs spro tshul dang*/ sdom pa chen po bshad pa'o// de la drug thig dang*/ tshon dang*/ sgo dang dur khrod kyi nges pa 'khor lo'i rtsis kyi sa bon/ go slas bskyed pa'i tshul/ zhar la gnas la sogs pa'i dgag pa'o/ de la lnga/ phyi'i gnas dang*/ khyim dang sbyar ba/ rtsa rgyud kyi lung*/ dur khrod la sogs pa'i sa bon dang bcas pa dang*/ gnas kyi nges pa rgyas bshad/ nang don du bshad pa'o// de la bzhi/ gnas nang du sbyar ba/ lte ba'i rlung 'pho ba la sbyar ba/ rlung gi dus sbyor la sngags kyi nges don dang*/ gdan gyi nges don no// drug pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i don du sngags dang*/ rlung bshad pa la bdun/ sngags ring thung thabs shes rab tu sbyar ba/ sngags rkang mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do// 'pho chung gi sa bon/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ dhū tī'i dbugs dang sbyar ba/ gdan gyi dag pa'o// de la lnga/

phyi nang gi 'dus pa'i gdan gyi dag pa/ 'khor lo sdom pa dang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gdan/ rlung la sogs pa'i zhal gyi dag pa/ stong pa chen po lnga'i rgyas 'debs/ zhal gyi dag pa'o// de la brgyad/ dus kyi dbye ba'i dag pa dang*/ rlung bzhi'i rnam dag dang*/ lus dang bsam pa'i 'jug pa/ shes rab kyi bsam pa'i dbye ba/ phan tshun 'khyud pa'i don/ dpyad mi bzod pa dpes bstan pa/ stong gzugs kyi don go sla/ de la gnyis/ bzhi tshan sbyar bshad dang*/ de rang sems su bstan pa'o// dang po la bcu gcig ste/ rgyud bzhi dang*/ grub mtha' bzhi dang*/ rigs byed bzhi/ 'jig rten gyi glu la sogs pa bzhi/ 'bras bu dus bzhi/ thun bzhi/ gnas skabs bzhi/ rigs bzhi/ sde pa bzhi/ 'gro ba bzhi/ 'khor lo bzhi'o// de rang sems su bstan pa la gsum/ sangs rgyas dang chos kyi mdzad pa dang*/ de rang sems yin pa'i tshul/ lam dpes bstan pa'o// de la drug sa bon dang myu gu'i dpe/ de nang du sbyar ba/ rten khams kyi tshul/ de'i spang gnyen/ de rtogs pa'i yon tan/ lam dang 'bras bu'o// bdun pa byang chub kyi sems sbyang ba la lnga/ khams dang 'byung ba'i dag pa/ sa bcur dag pa/ dbyangs dang gsal byed du dag pa/ go sla dang*/ phyag rgya'i don to// go sla la gnyis/ smon 'jug sbyang ba dang*/ gtum mo'i sbyor ba'o// dang po la lnga/ sems bskyed pa'i rgyu mtshan/ skye ba'i rgyu/ dbye ba/ mi mthun phyogs/ lam la slob tshul lo// de la lnga/ lam dang bdud mdor bstan/ kun rdzob tu sems can dang mthun par 'jug pa'i tshul de'i mi mthun phyogs bstan pa/ de dpes bshad pa/ don bsdu ba'o// gtum mo'i sbyor ba la gnyis/ phyag rgya bzhi'i rim pa/ gang du bsgom pa'i gnas so// lnga pa phyag rgya'i don la bcu gcig srog rtsol gyi sbyor ba dang*/ dngul chu'i dpes thig le brtan par 'gyur tshul/ las kyi phyag rgya'i lo'i rab dbye/ rigs kyi sras bsrung ba'i cho ga sa bon med pa dang*/

dge slong la dbang tshig gi sbyin pa/ khrag gi btung ba phyi nang du sbyar ba/ mi 'pho ba'i dam tshig bstan pa dgag pa dang bcas pa/ lus la brtan par bya ba/ bza' ba'i dam tshig srog bcad pa'i rgyu mtshan/ gang la yang ma chags par bya'o// gnyis pa sku bzhi la sogs pa bstan pa'i mdor bstan pa'i mdor bsdus la gnyis te/ mchod brjod bshad par dam bca' dang gzhung gi don to// de la gnyis/ sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa brtag pa dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang gi don gyis phyag rgya chen po bsgrub pa'o// dang po la bcu gcig ste/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku mtha' bzhi las grol ba dang*/ de la sku bzhi'i dbye ba dang*/ phrin las kyi dbye ba dang*/ khams dang dbang pos phye ba dang*/ sems can gyi bsam pas bzhugs gnas dang*/ go sla dang*/ dgug gzhug gi nges don dang*/ glus bskul ba'i nges don dang*/ rgyu des chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i don dang*/ sprul pa spro ba dang*/ de la 'bras bu gzhan du med pa'i tshul lo// go sla la brgyad/ bzhugs gnas phyi nang du sbyar ba/ 'khor gyi don/ dus kyi don/ sku'i 'phrin las/ gsung gi 'phrin las/ thugs kyi phrin las/ de rdo rje bzhir sbyar ba/ dkyil 'khor du snang ba thams cad kyi nges don no// de la lnga/ nus ma dang*/ rdo rje bzhi dang*/ rgyal ba dang*/ yum dang*/ skye mched kyi lha mo dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' drug gi nges don no// gnyis pa dbang gi don gyis phyag rgya chen po bsgrub pa la bzhi/ dbang gi don dngos dang*/ go sla dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi don bshad pa dang*/ de don bsgom pa'i tshul lo// de la bcu gsum ste/ nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor/ spyan lnga 'grub pa'i nges pa/ bum pa can gyi sbyor bas bsgom pa/ rlung 'gags pas sa thob pa'i nges pa/ de'i don bsdu/ stong gzugs kyi mtshan nyid/ rtsa gnas su 'gro ba'i lam/ rjes dran bsdu ba/

dkyil 'khor lnga dag par bya ba/ dga' ba bcu drug sbyang ba/ de brten par gyur pa'i 'bras bu/ gnas skabs bzhi dag pa'i 'bras bu/ rgyu des mi 'dzag pa bsngags pa'o// gsum pa ting nge 'dzin rnam par dag pa mchog tu mi 'gyur ba grub pa bstan pa'i mdor bsdus la bzhi/ phyag 'tshal ba/ gzhung dgod pa/ de rgyas par bshad pa/ don bsdu ba'o// rgyas bshad la drug mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes kyi don dgod pa/ dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi don bshad pa/ g.yo ba la mi 'gyur bar 'khrul pa'i tshul/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i don bshad pa/ nyams su blang ba'i thabs/ 'bras bu mi 'gyur ba nyid bstan pa'o// bzhi pa la lnga/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ shin tu rgyas bshad/ lung dang sbyar ba/ de dus kyi 'khor lo yin pa'i tshul lo// lnga pa nyams su blang thabs la gsum/ phyag rgya chen po dang*/ thun mong bsgrub pa'i nges pa mdor bstan/ sgrub mkhan gyi gang zag bstan pa/ rnam par brtags te nyams su blang ba'o// de la gsum ste/ bskyed rims dang bsam gtan phyogs re ba brtag pa/ phung po sangs rgyas su 'dod pa brtag pa/ mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i don nyams su blang ba'o// dang po la gsum/ rtog pa'i bsgom pas mchog mi 'grub pa'i tshul/ de la rgol ba dang lan gyis rtog bcas gsungs pa'i don mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad do// de la bzhi/ rten 'brel gyi nus pa'i don/ de phyogs re bar bstan pa/ sngags dang rdzas kyi nges pa dang*/ bsam gtan gyi don no// gsum pa la gnyis/ rgol ba dang*/ lan no// de la lnga/ sngags dang*/ sbyin bsreg dang*/ rdul tshon dang*/ phreng ba tha dad pa'i tshul/ ye shes kyi don de las gzhan pa lung dang sbyar ba'o// bsam gtan gyi don la bdun/ zad par dang dkyil 'khor spro ba'i don 'god pa/ rgol ba dang*/ lan mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad dang*/ bskyed rim sgom pa'i don dang ji ltar thams cad mkhyen par 'gyur ba'i tshul dang*/

de dag gi don bsdu ba'o// gnyis pa phung po sangs rgyas su 'dod pa brtag pa la gsum/ phung po brtag pa dngos dang*/ dam tshig gi rab dbye dang*/ yang dag pa'i rnal 'byor pa bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ lung gi don bshad pa dang*/ de lung rigs kyi gtan la dbab pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ phung po la sogs pa rang bzhin gyis sangs rgyas su rtog pa sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa'i tshul/ rtog pa goms pas sangs rgyas su mi 'gyur ba'o// 'og ma la bzhi/ rgol lan gyi sgra bshad pa'i tshul/ gzugs sku'i don lung gi bshad pa/ de ltar sprul sku mi 'thad ces rgol ba dang*/ lan no// de la bzhi/ gzugs sku snang ba bden pa ma yin pa'i don/ bden na yang dag pa ma yin pa'i skyon brjod pa/ de na sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul/ gzugs su bden na sems can gyi don bya mi nus pa'i rgyu mtshan no// de la bdun/ 'gro bas don mi nus pa'i tshul/ sngags la sogs pa mi nus pa'i tshul/ cha med khyab par 'dod na dbang phyug dang mtshungs pa'i skyon de nas bka' brtag pa/ bden gnyis bsgrub pa'i tshul/ lung sbyar ba/ don bsdu ba'o// dam tshig gi rab dbye la drug dam tshig sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa'i tshul/ don bshad pa/ bza' ba dang mi bza' ba'i nges pa/ rgol ba dang len dang*/ dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i nges pa'o// lan la bzhi/ lan dngos dang*/ las dang po pa'i bya ba yul lugs bshad pa/ spyod pa'i tshul lung dang bcas pa'o// dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i nges pa la lnga/ thun mong grub pa phyag rgya chen po ma yin pa'i tshul/ phyag rgya chen po'i don/ de rtogs tshul/ don bsdu ba/ gom stobs ma yin par bstan pa'o// yang dag pa'i rnal 'byor bshad pa la drug rnal 'byor grub pa'i nus pa/ rigs dbye ba*/ dbang bcu dang*/ sa bcu dang*/ phar phyin bcu dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi don bsdu ba'o// gsum pa mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i don nyams su blang ba la gsum/

phyag rgya chen po stong par 'dod pa dgag pa/ 'pho ba'i bde bar 'dod pa dgag pa dang*/ snang stong zung 'jug gi don dngos so// dang po la gsum/ thun mong la brten nas gol ba'i tshul/ mtshan nyid ldem dgongs ma gol ba'i tshul/ de dgag pa'o// de la gnyis te/ rigs pa'i skyon/ lung gi skyon no// de la gsum/ rin po che sgron ma'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rang rig gi ye shes yod par bstan pa/ rtsod pa spang ba/ ye shes de yang spros bral du lung gis bsgrub pa'o// gnyis pa 'pho ba'i bde bar 'dod pa dgag pa la gsum/ dbang gi don dgod pa/ rgyu mtshan des phung po med pa'i rang rig mi 'thad ces smra ba dang*/ de'i lan no// de la bzhi/ dbang gsum pa dang bzhi pa'i don bshad pa/ 'dzag med rtogs na ye shes su gyur tshul/ de la rgol ba dang*/ lan no/ de la brgyad/ phyag rgya'i dbye bas rgyu mthun dang mi 'gyur ba'i rab dbye/ mi 'gyur ba'i don lung gis bshad pa/ bzhi pa bsngags pa las rgya bstan pa'i don/ 'dzag pa las 'khor tshul/ 'dzag med du byed pa'i dpe dang*/ don bshad pa/ de lam du bstan pa/ de rgyas bshad do// de la gnyis/ yul med pa snang ba mi 'thad ces rgol ba dang*/ lan no// de la drug /rmi lam gyi mtshungs pa dang*/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul/ brgal lan gyi mu stegs kyi ma nges pa bsal/ 'khor ba'i tshul/ mi 'gyur ba'i nges pa/ khams gsum gyi 'pho ba 'pho med du bya ba'o// de la gnyis te/ lus med pa'i bde ba mi 'thad ces rgol ba khyab pa bsgrub pa dang bcas pa dang*/ de'i lan no// de la gnyis/ khams gsum gyi 'dzag pa mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad do// de la bzhi/ khams drug ldan mi ldan gyi dbye ba/ srid gsum gyi grangs/ khams 'pho ba'i nges pa lung dang bcas pa/ rgyu des sangs rgyas kyi chos bstan pa'i tshul lo// de la gnyis/ mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad do// de la drug log par lta ba'i tshul/

de spang ba'i phyir bye brag smra ba dang*/ mdo sde pa dang*/ sems tsam dang*/ dbu ma dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// gsum pa snang stong zung 'jug gi don bshad pa la gsum/ rnal 'byor gyi nyams su myong tshul/ de la brgal ba dang*/ lan no// de la gsum/ pra'i dpes bstan pa dang*/ bla ma rgyur smra ba dgag pa dang*/ 'pho med ma thob par zag med kyi mngon shes med par bstan pa'o// dang po la drug /bems po ma yin pa snang ba'i tshul/ ma nges pa brjod pa/ de spang ba/ pra se na mthong ba'i rgyu mtshan/ mngon shes kyang de dang 'dra ba'i tshul/ brgal lan gyis de la ma nges pa spang ba'o// gnyis pa la lnga/ dpon slob rmongs pa'i tshul/ ye shes dbab pa'i nges pa/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i don/ de la gdams pa/ mchog 'dod pas phra mo mi bsgrub pa'i tshul lo// gsum pa 'pho med ma thob par zag med kyi mngon shes med par bstan pa la gnyis/ mngon shes kyi rgol lan dang*/ rten 'brel gyi don no/ dang po la gnyis/ chos 'phags dang rgyas pa'i dpe rgol ba dang*/ lan no// de la gnyis/ byang chub sems dpa'i don dang*/ phyi rol pa sun dbyung ba'o// dang po la brgyad/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ byang chub kyi sems sbyong tshul/ dpes bshad pa/ de'i lam/ mdor rgyas kyis bshad pa/ yon tan gyi khyad par bstan pa/ de nang du sbyar ba/ dpes 'thad pa bstan pa'o/ phyi rol pa sun dbyung ba la bzhi/ rgyas pa'i mngon shes mi bden pa'i rgyu mtshan/ mu stegs kyi gzhung brdzun pa'i tshul/ de snga yang don med pa'i rigs/ zhar la sangs rgyas khyab 'jug gi 'jug par 'dod pa dgag pa'o// de la gsum/ phyi rol pa'i 'dod tshul/ de dgag pa/ rtsod pa sgra ji bzhin ma yin par bstan pa'o// rten 'brel gyi don la gnyis te/ 'khor ba'i rgyu la the tshom 'jug tshul/ de bshad pa'o// de la bdun/ mdor bstan dang*/ 'dzag pa las ma rig par 'gyur tshul/

rten 'brel rgyas bshad/ de mngal gyi gnas skabs dang sbyar ba lung dang bcas pa/ de dag pa sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba'i tshul/ de la rgol ba dang*/ lan no// de la bzhi/ bdud phyi rol na med pa'i tshul/ bdud kyi dbye ba/ bye brag tu phyi rol nyan thos kyi lha'i bu'i bdud bshad pa/ de'i log rtog spang ba lung dang bcas pa'o// rgyas bshad kyi drug pa 'bras bu mi 'gyur ba nyid bstan pa la gnyis/ rang sems rdo rje sems dpa' yin pa'i tshul mdor bstan dang*/ rgyas bshad do// de la gnyis/ rang snang gi bdud bcom nas sangs rgyas tshul/ mi 'gyur ba'i don lung gis bshad pa'o// de la lnga/ don mi shes pa 'byung ba'i tshul/ don rtsa rgyud kyi lung gis bshad pa/ bsdus rgyud kyis bshad pa/ mtshan brjod kyis bshad pa/ don de bsgoms byar gdams pa'o// don bsdu ba la gsum/ mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes kyi bsgom bya rtsa rgyud kyi lung gis bstan pa/ bsdus rgyud kyis bshad pa/ don bsdu ba'o// bzhi pa sna tshogs pa gdul byar mdor bstan pa la gnyis te/ mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba dang*/ gzhung gi don no// de la bdun te/ chos bstan pa de'i rang bzhin du gnas pa/ skye bsdud pa bstan pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdo rjes byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ bcud len bstan pa dang*/ don byed pa'i thabs phra mo bstan pa dang*/ rtsis dang chos kyi tha snyad bsdu ba dang*/ don bsdus pa'i bstod pa'o// dang po la bdun/ g.yon gyi 'pho ba dbyangs thung ngu dang sbyar ba/ g.yas su ring po sbyar ba/ dbu ma'i rlung lnga bcu rtsa drug /bzhi cha'i sa bon bshad pa/ zhag gi dbugs kyi sa bon/ sgra gcan gyi zla gcig gi longs spyod nang du sbyar ba/ nyi zla'i shol nang du sbyar ba/ lha la sogs pa'i sbyar bshad do/ de la bdun/ pho nya sum cu so drug gi longs spyod/ rnal 'byor ma'i sbyar bshad/ rtsar srog rgyu ba rlung gis bshad pa/

gsang ba'i rtsa dgyes rdor dang sbyar ba/ rtsa gzhan rnal 'byor mar bshad pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag rgya'i dag pa/ gza'i longs spyod la sogs pa'i rgyu ba bshad pa'o// de la bcu gsum ste/ mkha' 'gro dang sbyar bas sku gsung thugs kyi thig le bskyed pa'i rim pa/ go sla dang*/ zla ba la sgra gcan 'jug tshul/ gzas 'dzin 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan/ gdams pa dang bcas pa/ gza' rnams kyi bshad pa/ zhal gyi dbye ba'i dus bstan pa/ de'i go sla/ byis pa'i dbugs rgyu ba'i mtshan nyid/ 'khor lo drug tu rlung rgyu ba sde tshan gyi dbye ba/ dus kyi rab dbye/ lo dang nyin mtshan gyi rnam dag /sde tshan gyi rab dbye bcing ba/ go sla bstan pa'o// gnyis pa bskyed pa dang sdud pa bstan pa la gsum/ rdo rje'i dbugs la gza' rgyu ba bstan pa/ nang gi don go slas bshad pa/ zhing khams nang du sbyar ba'o// gnyis pa la bcu/ gza' dgu stong par 'jug pa'i tshul rtsa rlung 'phel tshul dang sbyar ba/ de'i nges pa/ de thams cad du khyab pa'i tshul de dag gi byed pa grub pa'i yon tan/ dbu ma'i dngas snyigs rgyu tshul/ de srog rtsol gyis sbyang tshul/ nang gi nyi zla 'dzin pa'i tshul/ thig le dang srog rlung dag pa'i yon tan/ des sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba'i rgyas bshad do// zhing khams nang du sbyar ba la brgyad/ 'jig rten gyi khams nye bar bsdu ba/ nges don gyi zhing khams/ 'jig rten gyi khams skye ba/ zhing bkod pa rtsa la sbyar ba/ ri rab kyi mtshan nyid/ dkyil 'khor dang sbyar ba/ lus dang sbyar ba/ lus la dkyil 'khor gyi rnam dag nang don du sbyar ba'o// de la lnga/ dag pa dngos/ ri rab/ khor yug dang*/ dur khrod/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i dkyil 'khor/ grub pa nang du dag pa'o// gsum pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdo rjes byin gyis brlab pa bstan pa la bcu gsum ste/ rdo rje dril bu'i mtshan nyid dag pa dang*/ mchod rten gyi dag pa/ skyes bu chen po'i mtshan bshad pa/

chos yang dag par bsdud pa dang*/ dpe byad bsod nams la grub bo zhes pa'i go sla dang*/ lcags la sogs pa'i khams bstan pa/ ro bstan pa/ nor bu'i yon tan/ go sla dang*/ khyim 'byung tshul/ gza'i khyim/ rtsi bcud kyi yon tan mi mthong ba'i tshul/ sangs rgyas kyi phrin las bstan pa/ go sla'o// de la drug /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i mdzad pa/ spang byas ngos bzung ba/ spong byed ston pa la gus pa bya ba/ zhe sdang dang*/ 'dod chags dang*/ gti mug gzhom par gdams pa'o// bzhi pa bcud len bstan pa la gsum/ rdzas thams cad spyir bstan pa/ bye brag tu dngul chu bstan pa/ lus dang longs spyod bsgrub pa'o// dang po la bdun/ ro bcud dang nye ba'i bcud bshad pa/ bkru ba'i rdzas/ chu lnga'i khams/ rtsa dang nye ba'i dug /lhang tsher dang khab len/ dngul chu rab dbye de rnams sdeb pa dang gsad pa'o// gnyis pa la drug dngul chu'i gnas skabs kyi dbye ba/ yon tan/ sbyin pa'i nges pa go sla/ 'bigs pa'i rim pa/ go slas sbyang zhing bkru ba'i rim pa/ bsrung ba'i don du 'dzam bha la bshad pa'o// de la gsum/ rgyu dang*/ sku bya ba bskyed pa dang bcas pa/ chu sbyin pa'o// gsum pa lus dang longs spyod bsgrub pa la bcu gcig /bkru ba dang*/ lcags thams cad bza' ba dang*/ btso ba'i tshad dang*/ rag rdo'i phan yon/ lhang tsher sbyar ba/ mes bcing ba/ 'ching ba'i dgos pa/ gong bu bcing ba/ khams kyi bcing ba/ gser 'gyur dang bza' thabs bstan pa'o/ gser 'gyur la gnyis/ phyed 'gyur dang*/ rtsa rgyud kyi lugs bstan pa'o// bza' thabs la bdun/ sngon 'gro dang spyod lam/ bza' ba'i tshad/ gegs sel gyi sman/ bcud len gyi sman gyi mtshan nyid/ mu zi dang sbyar ba'i bcud len/ gsod pa'i sman/ de dag gi don bstan pa'o// lnga pa don byed pa'i thabs phra mo bstan pa la lnga/ gter brtag pa'i thabs/ go slas sna tshogs pa bsgrub pa'i nges pa/ rigs kyi dbye ba/

nang gi khams kyi skye ba/ 'dun pa la sogs pa'i dbye ba'o// drug pa rtsis dang chos kyi tha snyad bsdu ba la bcu ste/ chos rnams kyi tha snyad bsdus te gnyis tshan bshad pa/ sum tshan dang*/ bzhi tshan dang*/ lnga tshan dang*/ drug tshan dang*/ bdun tshan dang*/ brgyad tshan dang*/ dgu tshan dang*/ bcu tshan la sogs pas bsdus pa dang*/ rtsis kyi tha snyad bsdu ba'o// bdun pa don bsdus te bstod pa la brgyad/ rgyud kyi yon tan/ rnam pa lngar bstod pa dang po dang*/ gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa dang*/ bzhi pa dang*/ lnga pa dang*/ thig le stong pa yi ge drug la bstod pa dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal ba'o// le'u lnga pa'i rjes kyi don la gnyis te/ rtsa ba dang*/ 'grel pa'o// dang po la gsum/ gtad cing gdams pa dang*/ nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs pas bstod pa/ rgyud gtad cing 'grel par lung bstan pa'o// dang po la lnga/ blang dor brtag pa/ gdams pa/ ji ltar bsdus tshul/ pad dkar la ston cig par gdams pa/ bsngo ba dang sngags so// gnyis pa la gnyis/ btud de phyag 'tshal ba/ bstod cing smon lam btab pa'o// 'grel pa la gnyis/ bsdus rgyud bsdus te ji ltar bskul ba'i tshul/ bsngo ba'o// ye shes kyi le'u'i bsdus don no// dpal ldan rgyal bas bla med rgyud rgyal bstan pa gang*// ye shes sku 'dzin 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis nyung bsdus pa// phyag na pad mos rnam par 'grel mdzad zab mo'i don// rtogs par bya phyir bsdus don 'di ni nyer bsdus so// mkha' ltar dpag med dang po'i sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa// dri med 'od 'phro zung 'jug lam ni snang byed pa// bsdus don mig gi rang gi blo yi mthus ma byas// spyan ras gzigs dbang mthu yis bskul nas byas pa yin// de las dge ba dri med rab gsal ci yod pas// mtha' yas sems can rgyal ba'i ye shes thob par shog /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsdus don dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi tshul gsal bar byed pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba/
